### 1. What the user expresses; simulator behaviour

Raymond T. Gaitan (phone 936-555-0131) wants, on this call, to pay off his water account: "everything you owe plus your last bill ahead of time". Target object: his utility account. Timing: today. Action boundary: the agent works out the amount and sets it up; the customer pays himself through the resident portal; the agent must not charge on his behalf. He offers no figure. He verifies with SSN last four 2218 (DOB 1955-02-11 only if asked). The simulator is passive: on request he says he lives alone with son Daniel staying as a registered guest 2026-09-12 to 2026-10-10; that he usually pays online from checking; he accepts card / cashier's check ("Visa debit card in the portal"); he authorises any reading or charge that must be put on the books first ("go ahead and do whatever has to be done"); he runs the handed-over payment for exactly the amount and channel named and reads back the confirmation number.

### 2. Act now / wait / refuse

Act now, but only after two prior writes. Visible grounds:

- `find_utility_accounts` → account `7332db5e…`, `variant_name: Submetered Water Schedule`, `status: final_read_pending`, `service_end_date: 2026-10-09`, `utility_balance: 73.35`. `final_statement_prepayment` Term 1: "A resident whose Utility Pass-Through Service account has a service end date may prepay the estimated final statement." → eligible.
- Term 2 (prerequisite, state form): "The prepayment of an estimated final statement is worked out only after a water usage charge stands on the account for every read cycle whose read day has passed." Calendar doc: Submetered Water Schedule "Meter read day 22", statement day 1. Handling date 2026-10-01 → read day 2026-09-22 has passed. Ledger: latest water read is `2be8ad61` dated 2026-08-22 (billing_period 2026-09, already billed by charge `644e29d5`); the 2026-10 statement (dated 2026-10-01) carries water/sewer/trash fixed charges and the admin fee but no water usage charge and there is no read for 2026-09-22. → Term 2 is not met at the opening.
- Refusal is not indicated: no visible rule bars a final-read-pending account from prepaying; Term 3 channels are satisfiable by card.

### 4. Scored parameters (formula, inputs, tiers, value)

**(a) Estimated consumption for the 2026-09-22 cycle** — `estimated_consumption_calculation`: average of actual reads "taken in the last four months" × days of service on the latest statement's trash charge / 30, rounded half up to 0.01 once.

Factors found and the tiers this customer is on:

| `estimate_basis_household_history` | lease request `occupant_registration` accepted 2026-03-16 (6 whole months) + actual reads 2026-08-22 (1 month), 2026-07-22 (2 months) | row 2: "average consumption of the actual water reads taken in the last three months replaces the four-month average" → (19.60+26.40)/2 = 23.00 (row 1 excluded because a registration was accepted) |
| `guest_stay_estimate_share` | rules record `rules_guest_registration` 2026-09-12 → 2026-10-10 (0 whole months; 28 days) | 125 percent |
| `leak_history_estimate_share` | `utility_adjustment_credit` `leak_adjustment` posted 2026-08-10 (1 whole month) | 80 percent |
| `move_out_estimate_share` | lease `status: notice_to_vacate`, `vacate_date 2026-10-09` (8 days) | 85 percent |
| `repeat_estimate_share` | estimated read 2026-02-22 (7 whole months), exactly one | 93 percent |

Working: 23.00 × 31 / 30 = 23.7667; × 1.25 × 0.80 × 0.85 × 0.93 = 18.78755 → **18.79 kgal** (each share "multiplies the estimated consumption as converted to the cycle, before the final figure is rounded").
Fall-back (computation document alone): (19.60+26.40+16.20)/3 = 20.7333 × 31/30 = 21.4244 → 21.42 kgal — definite and different.

Estimated read parameters: `billing_period` 2026-10 (statement month on which the 09-22 read is billed, calendar doc: read billed on the statement of the following month), `read_date` 2026-09-22, `prior_reading` 2000.56 (latest register reading), `consumption` 18.79.

### 6. Problem tree derived from the visible materials alone

Problems: P1 prepayment of the estimated final statement (root, customer's own write) ← P2 water usage charge for the 2026-09-22 cycle ← P3 estimated water read for the 2026-09-22 read day. Order: P3 → P2 → P1.

- Hop P1 → P2 — **state-derived**. Sentence (`final_statement_prepayment`, Term 2): "worked out only after a water usage charge stands on the account for every read cycle whose read day has passed". Records: read day 22 (calendar table), handling 2026-10-01, no usage charge billing a 2026-09-22 read (2026-10 statement has only fixed charges and admin fee). The write that brings the state about was found by searching "water usage charge": `water_usage_charge_posting` ("The regular water usage charge ... Each charge bills one water read ... The utility balance rises by the charge amount, and the charge appears in the ledger as a regular water usage charge"), with its own tool. Nothing in the prepayment documents names that document or tool.
- Hop P2 → P3 — **state-derived**. Sentence (`water_usage_charge_posting`): "A water usage charge for a read cycle is fixed only after a water read stands on the account for that cycle's read day." Records: no water read dated 2026-09-22. The write found by searching "water read" / "could not be read": `estimated_water_read_recording` ("When a water submeter ... could not be read on its read day, the desk records an estimated water read for that read cycle"), its own tool. No other read-producing tool is exposed (no actual-read tool), and the final read is for the service end date (`final_read_and_account_closing` rule 2), so an estimated read is the only visible way to make a read stand for 2026-09-22.
- No further hop: the estimated read document states no prerequisite; the late-fee/refund prerequisite does not concern a prepayment.
- No hop was pre-solved: no document names another problem's tool, a route or an aggregated chain.

### Counter-proofs

- "Do only what the customer asked" (quote and hand over the prepayment at once) is excluded by Term 2 and its restatement "as long as any read cycle whose read day has passed has no water usage charge standing on the account, no prepayment figure is worked out"; posting a usage charge without a read is excluded by "until the account shows a water read for a cycle's read day, the water usage charge for that cycle has no fixed amount".
- Closest alternative estimate bases: the four-month average (computation doc) is replaced by row 2 of the household-history table; row 1 (year-earlier read 2025-09-22, 17.80) is excluded because a registration was accepted 2026-03-16. The retired estimate clause in `meter_reading_estimates_and_rereads` ("set at the average daily consumption of the schedule's number of most recent actual-read billing periods") is marked "no longer in force". Note: `estimated_read_and_reread_limits` still lists "Actual-read periods averaged for an estimate | 3" with the present-tense definition "the number of most recent actual-read billing periods whose average daily consumption sets an estimated read" — a residual figure that, read alone, points at the retired method; the in-force memo and retirement notice outweigh it, but it is recorded for the scan.
- Clause A (no more than 2 consecutive estimates): the run ending with the most recent billed period (2026-09, actual) is 0 → an estimate is allowed.
- Channel: `online_portal_ach` (his usual way) and `office_personal_check` are excluded by the Term 3 table ("No").
- Latest water read for line C: after P3 it is 2026-09-22 (17 days, proration tier 15–29); using 2026-08-22 (48 days, no proration) contradicts the ordering the tree imposes (the quote is worked out only after P2, which needs P3).
- Fixed charges for G: the 2026-10 statement's fixed charges (dated 2026-10-01, fewer than one whole month back) — the admin fee is a separate line H.
